details: aia-b-locator-fe@1.0.2 ships only two files (package.json and index.js, 467 bytes unpacked) and has no functional code beyond an install-time callback. Its package.json declares the lifecycle hook "preinstall": "node index.js", and index.js performs a DNS resolution of the unique out-of-band-callback subdomain ojoecyzdevxakimabqtr9bimrjqhw66z[.]oast[.]fun, then prints "preinstall callback triggered" and exits. Installing this package therefore contacts an operator-controlled interactsh-style collector to confirm that the package was installed on the host. The package carries no description, no README, no repository, no exports and no other behaviour; nothing is read from the host in this version and no credentials or files are collected — the install-time DNS callback is the entire payload. IOC: DNS A queries for ojoecyzdevxakimabqtr9bimrjqhw66z[.]oast[.]fun at install time.
